_method: COCO person detector, tallest detection per frame as the foreground worker; lane = green paint with G - max(R,B) > 15; distance is the minimum Euclidean pixel distance from the worker's feet to a lane pixel, at full source resolution 1920x1080.
_why_distance_not_x: A fixed x threshold cannot be compared across different crops and camera views. Distance to that clip's own lane pixels is defined per source.
_not_safety: Distance from paint is geometry, not a safety judgement.
